WITH date_subset AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
),
web_daily AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT w.item_sk, d.d_date, SUM(w.daily_sales) AS daily_sales
    FROM (
        SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
               ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
               SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS daily_sales
        FROM web_sales ws
        WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM date_subset ds WHERE ds.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk)
        GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    ) AS w
    JOIN date_subset d ON w.sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY w.item_sk, d.d_date
    ORDER BY w.item_sk, d.d_date
),
store_daily AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s.item_sk, d.d_date, SUM(s.daily_sales) AS daily_sales
    FROM (
        SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
               ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
               SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS daily_sales
        FROM store_sales ss
        WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM date_subset ds WHERE ds.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk)
        GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    ) AS s
    JOIN date_subset d ON s.sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY s.item_sk, d.d_date
    ORDER BY s.item_sk, d.d_date
),
web_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM web_daily
    ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
),
store_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM store_daily
    ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
),
joined AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN web.item_sk IS NOT NULL THEN web.item_sk ELSE store.item_sk END AS item_sk,
           CASE WHEN web.d_date IS NOT NULL THEN web.d_date ELSE store.d_date END AS d_date,
           web.cume_sales AS web_sales,
           store.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM web_v1 web
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_v1 store
      ON web.item_sk = store.item_sk AND web.d_date = store.d_date
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           web_sales,
           store_sales,
           MAX(web_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS web_cumulative,
           MAX(store_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS store_cumulative
    FROM joined
)
SELECT item_sk,
       d_date,
       web_sales,
       store_sales,
       web_cumulative,
       store_cumulative
FROM cumulative
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
